title: Block Reader
description: A lightweight accessibility reader that speaks targeted blocks, entities, UI elements, and inventory items for visually impaired players.
body:
# Block Reader

Block Reader is a client-side accessibility mod for visually impaired Minecraft players. It reads out the block, entity, UI element, or inventory item currently under your crosshair or mouse cursor.

## Requiring
- Fabric API
- Cloth Config API

## Features

- Reads targeted blocks and entities
- Reads hovered UI elements and inventory items
- Low-latency reading mode using Minecraft's built-in narrator
- Optional system TTS mode with custom voices and speech rate control
- Follows the selected Minecraft language for names and messages
- Separate toggles for pointed blocks, entities, UI, and inventory contents
- Cloth Config settings screen
- Default `J` keybind to open settings based on Cloth Config

## Commands

```text
/mcreader config
/mcreader test
/mcreader rate <80-1000>
/mcreader voice <voice name>
/mcreader voices
/mcreader enabled true|false
